properties.name: The Marquis Brickell
properties.tagline: Unrivaled Architectural Heights Above Biscayne Bay
properties.shortDescription: A soaring 64-story glass monolith defining the Miami skyline, offering 360-degree water vistas and private sky garages.
properties.overview: Rising majestically over Brickell Avenue, The Marquis combines monumental structural engineering with whisper-quiet, private sanctuary living. Every residence occupies a full or half-floor footprint, complete with bespoke Italian millwork, 12-foot floor-to-ceiling acoustic glass, and sweeping terraces overlooking Biscayne Bay and the Atlantic ocean.

sections.title: The Grand Living Volume
sections.subtitle: Level 52 • Double-Height Vistas Over Biscayne Bay
sections.description: Dramatic 24-foot soaring ceilings framed by bronze mullions and ultra-clear acoustic glass. Fluted French limestone walls and wide-plank European white oak underfoot create an atmosphere of effortless grandeur.

sections.title: The Culinary Atelier
sections.subtitle: Precision Craftsmanship by Poliform & Gaggenau
sections.description: Sculpted monolithic island in honed Calacatta Monet marble. Concealed cabinetry with automated tactile touch latches, integrated refrigeration, and a dedicated temperature-zoned sommelier alcove.

sections.title: The Master Sanctuary
sections.subtitle: East-Facing Sunrise Suite Over Atlantic Horizon
sections.description: A secluded wing featuring dual bespoke dressing suites with integrated glass vitrines, a midnight refreshment bar, and a freestanding monolithic soaking tub positioned at the perimeter glass.

sections.title: The Sunset Sky Oasis
sections.subtitle: Cantilevered Private Plunge Pool & Summer Kitchen
sections.description: Over 1,800 square feet of seamless indoor-outdoor living. Features a heated glass-bottom infinity plunge pool, automated wind-deflection screens, and a marine-grade stainless outdoor kitchen.

properties.name: Aura Biscayne
properties.shortDescription: Flowing organic architecture sculpted directly along the bay shoreline with private deep-water marina access.
properties.overview: Aura Biscayne reimagines waterfront living with sinuous curves and open-air loggias that catch the ocean breezes. Each residence features flow-through layouts with both sunrise ocean views and sunset city skyline horizons.

sections.title: The Waterfront Pavilion
sections.subtitle: Continuous Glass Curve Meeting the Waterline
sections.description: Walls of continuous glass curve gently to capture the changing hues of Biscayne Bay from dawn until twilight. Hand-rubbed plaster finishes and warm teak accents bring nautical grace into every corner.

sections.title: The Marina Vista Terrace
sections.subtitle: Direct Line-of-Sight to Private Yacht Slips
sections.description: Deep sheltered terraces designed for year-round entertaining. Step directly down to the private marina promenade or relax while watching yachts cruise along the Intracoastal.

properties.name: The Palma Coconut Grove
properties.shortDescription: Nestled under ancient banyan canopies, these low-density modernist estates blend lush tropical landscapes with uncompromising privacy.
properties.overview: The Palma Coconut Grove is an exclusive enclave of 28 boutique estates surrounded by lush botanical gardens. Designed for discerning art collectors and privacy seekers, each home features expansive gallery walls and private courtyard gardens.

sections.title: The Art Collector's Atrium
sections.subtitle: Museum-Grade Lighting & Monumental Wall Dimensions
sections.description: Engineered specifically for significant contemporary art collections, featuring UV-filtering glass, precision climate-humidity control, and reinforced exhibition walls.

sections.title: The Banyan Courtyard
sections.subtitle: Private Outdoor Sanctuary Framed by Native Flora
sections.description: An intimate private courtyard featuring water walls, mature native orchids, and outdoor fireplace lounges crafted from hand-cut Oolite stone.

properties.name: Vela Star Island
properties.tagline: The Pinnacle of Ultra-Exclusive Island compounds
properties.shortDescription: Six ultra-rare gated compounds on Miami's most legendary private island, featuring 200 feet of deep-water bay frontage.
properties.overview: Vela represents the absolute zenith of South Florida luxury. Set behind a 24-hour guard-gated causeway, each compound features private staff quarters, security outposts, and dockage capable of accommodating mega-yachts with quick open ocean access.
amenitiesHighlight: Private Wellness Spa with Cryotherapy Chamber

sections.title: The Oceanfront Great Room
sections.subtitle: Zero-Post Corner Openings Over Miami Skyline
sections.description: Massive motorized pocketing glass doors vanish entirely into the architecture, erasing the distinction between interior luxury and the sparkling turquoise waters of Biscayne Bay.

neighborhoods.name: Brickell Financial District
neighborhoods.tagline: The Manhattan of the South with Subtropical Glamour
neighborhoods.description: Miami's pulsing epicenter of global finance, Michelin-starred dining, and soaring architectural towers overlooking Biscayne Bay.
keyFeatures: Direct water taxi & private marina docks

neighborhoods.name: Edgewater Bay
neighborhoods.description: Directly facing Biscayne Bay and adjacent to the Design District and Wynwood, Edgewater offers prime shoreline residences with uninhibited maritime views.
keyFeatures: Margaret Pace Park waterfront jogging & tennis
Minutes to Miami Design District luxury flagships

neighborhoods.name: Coconut Grove
neighborhoods.tagline: Historic Charm, Tropical Canopies & Bohemian Luxury
neighborhoods.description: Miami's oldest and most enchanting neighborhood, defined by lush canopy-lined roads, prestigious sailing clubs, and private gated sanctuaries.
keyFeatures: Biscayne Bay Yacht Club & Coral Reef Yacht Club
Ancient banyan and tropical nature reserves

neighborhoods.name: Miami Beach & Star Island
neighborhoods.description: The world's most recognizable luxury playground, offering guarded private islands, white-sand Atlantic beaches, and international cultural events.
keyFeatures: Immediate ocean access without fixed bridges

amenities.title: Cantilevered Sky Pools & Terraces
amenities.tagline: Suspended between the heavens and the ocean horizon
amenities.description: Heated acrylic and glass-bottom pools suspended hundreds of feet above the bay, accompanied by private cabanas, dedicated towel attendants, and twilight mixology service.
features: Private VIP cabanas with smart media

amenities.title: Deep-Water Private Marinas
amenities.tagline: Seamless nautical departures directly from your residence
amenities.description: Full-service private slips accommodating superyachts up to 150 feet with on-demand fueling, dockmaster support, and private yacht tender provisions.

amenities.title: Holistic Hydrotherapy & Wellness Spas
amenities.tagline: A restorative sanctuary for mind, body, and vitality
amenities.description: Custom thermal suites featuring Finnish cedar saunas, Himalayan salt relaxation rooms, cold plunge pools, and private treatment suites serviced by premier therapists.

amenities.title: Curated Wine Vaults & Private Dining
amenities.tagline: Uncompromising epicurean excellence in complete privacy
amenities.description: Climate-controlled private cellar lockers with master sommelier curation, tasting tables carved from single walnut slabs, and catering kitchens for guest celebrity chefs.
